dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge with a smooth inward spline curvature from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the morphological vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc describing the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak profile extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light refraction patterns distributed across the dorsal and lateral pixel regions.
